correctness.rationale: PASS: The equation g(2y-x)=2g(y)-g(x) with g(0)=0 forces g(-x)=-g(x), g(2x)=2g(x), and g(x+t)=g(x)+h(t) for t∈2A. The restriction h is invertible on 2A and all GL_d(Z/2^{k-1}) automorphisms lift. The kernel is exactly parity-coset functions e:A/2A→A[2], e(0)=0, bijective because A[2]⊆2A; its order is 2^{d(2^d-1)}. Combining GL cardinalities yields the stated index and |F|. Every g0 preserves the valuation filtration; affine GL transitive on each shell proves identical ordered-pair orbitals. At k=d=2 this gives F0 order384, F order6144, H order1536, shells of sizes1,3,12; verifier source enumerates 384 maps and all 16² quandle identities. No splitting of exact sequence claimed.
